offlineBonusHelp.title: Offline bonus rules
offlineBonusHelp.noIncome: Time away grants no direct XP, items or currency. Instead, it prepares an XP and effective Magic Find bonus for your next online session.
offlineBonusHelp.accrual: Each hour away adds +8% bonus (up to +50%) and 20 minutes of bonus time (up to 2 hours).
offlineBonusHelp.decay: The bonus decreases linearly to zero during online play. It does not boost currency, rune or gem drops, or first-kill bonuses.
